Varterm TTS - full context for language models

Canonical site:
https://varterm.com

Product:
Varterm TTS converts text to natural speech for web and extension workflows.
It is optimized for long-form listening, markdown-heavy content, and AI-generated output.

Core capabilities:
1) Web text-to-speech playback with cloud, browser, and offline voice modes.
2) Long-form chunked generation/playback for large documents.
3) Markdown sanitization for cleaner speech.
4) API endpoints for voice listing and synthesis.
5) Extension workflows for Cursor/VS Code and Chrome browser use cases.
6) Editor Auto-read for the agent window, with play / pause / stop / jump on the status bar.

Primary user intents:
- "read this long text aloud"
- "convert markdown to speech"
- "listen to ChatGPT/AI output"
- "text to speech in Cursor/VS Code"
- "browser page read aloud"
